setting.en: A visit to the family doctor in Šempeter. You have had a sore throat and a headache for three days.
setting.de: Ein Besuch beim Hausarzt in Šempeter. Seit drei Tagen hast du Halsschmerzen und Kopfweh.
setting.it: Una visita dal medico di famiglia a Šempeter. Da tre giorni hai mal di gola e mal di testa.

role: Dr. Kovač, a calm family doctor. Speaks slowly and clearly, asks one simple question at a time. Says vi to patients.
